description: This file defines the UsernamePasswordCredentials class used for handling user authentication credentials within the OpenMRS platform. It implements the Credentials interface and encapsulates username and password information.

classes.name: UsernamePasswordCredentials
classes.description: Represents user-pass credentials for authentication in OpenMRS, including methods for retrieving username, password, and authentication scheme.

methods.name: UsernamePasswordCredentials
methods.description: Constructor initializing username and password fields.

methods.name: getAuthenticationScheme
methods.description: Returns the authentication scheme identifier for username-password credentials.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Retrieves the username component of the credentials.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the password component of the credentials.

methods.name: getClientName
methods.description: Returns the client name, which in this context defaults to the username.
